The symbols below distinguish numerical controls from model parameters. The
public estimator defaults are those of `FastHuberCD`. Experiments use the
explicit overrides in the second table. Mathematical constants such as the
factor $1/2$ in the loss are not tuning parameters.

| Symbol | Software control or operation | Default |
|:--|:--|:--|
| $\epsilon$ | Joint optimality tolerance, `tol` | $10^{-7}$ |
| $K$ | Outer iteration limit, `max_iter` | 2000 |
| $B$ | MM steps per scale update, `scale_mm_steps` | 8 |
| $\epsilon_\sigma$ | Scale-block tolerance, `scale_inner_tol` | $\epsilon/2$ |
| $T$ | Root/splitting iteration limit, `scale_max_iter` | 2000 |
| $\gamma$ | Normalized proximal step, `prox_gamma` | 1 |
| $c_\kappa$ | Full-check interval, `check_every` | 5 |
| $p_N$ | Support-step interval, `newton_every` | 5, 0 disables |
| $q_N$ | Maximum support size for a Newton step | 128 |
| $c_H$ | Relative diagonal ridge for the direction | $10^{-10}$ |
| $c_A$ | Armijo constant | $10^{-4}$ |
| $\omega$ | Backtracking factor | $1/2$ |
| $K_N$ | Maximum backtracking trials | 24 |
| $\tau_\sigma$ | Small-scale threshold relative to response SD | $10^{-10}$ |
| $\epsilon_{\rm LP}$ | LP primal/dual feasibility tolerance | $10^{-9}$ |
| $K_\mu$ | Maximum local-prox root iterations | 80 |
| $\epsilon_\mu$ | Local-prox interval tolerance | $10^{-14}$ |
| $c_{\rm init}$ | Response-SD fraction in automatic initialization | $10^{-3}$ |

: Numerical controls of the optimized implementation. Support size, ridge, backtracking, small-scale and LP constants are recorded implementation settings. The other named estimator controls can be supplied at construction. {#tbl-controls}

Automatic scale initialization is
$\max\{\mathrm{MAD}(y)/\Phi^{-1}(3/4),c_{\rm init}\mathrm{SD}(y),
\epsilon_{\rm mach}\}$, using the implementation's approximation to the
Gaussian MAD constant. The small-scale threshold triggers a boundary check.
It does not constrain the fitted scale. Boundary acceptance requires a
normalized primal–dual gap at most the outer tolerance $\epsilon$.

| Study | Named settings |
|:--|:--|
| ROME simulation | $\epsilon_{\rm sim}=10^{-6}$, $K_{\rm sim}=4000$, $B=8$, $c_\kappa=p_N=5$ |
| Native ROME | $\epsilon_{\rm ROME}=10^{-4}$, $K_{\rm ROME}=100000$, native iterate-change stopping |
| Independent simulation audit | Practical normalized-gap threshold $\epsilon_{\rm gap}=10^{-4}$, strict checks use $\epsilon_{\rm sim}$ |
| R4 CD | $\epsilon_{\rm R4}=10^{-5}$, $K_{\rm R4}=3000$, $B=8$, no support Newton step |
| R4 reference | $\epsilon_{\rm ref}=10^{-9}$, $K_{\rm ref}=10000$ |
| R4 comparison | $\epsilon_{\rm obj}=10^{-8}$, penalty fraction $f_{\rm R4}=0.6$ |
| R4 DR | $c_{\rm DR}=1$, $K_{\rm DR}=5000$, external check every $c_{\rm DRcheck}=10$ updates |
| Trajectory | $\epsilon_{\rm trace}=10^{-8}$, $K_{\rm trace}=10000$ |
| Real-data CV | $\epsilon_{\rm CV}=10^{-6}$, $K_{\rm CV}=20000$ |
| CV tie rule | $\epsilon_{\rm tie}=10^{-10}$ times $\max\{1,|\min\mathrm{MSE}|\}$, we select the largest penalty |
| Null-model roots | Location tolerance $\epsilon_b=10^{-13}$, scale tolerance $\epsilon_0=10^{-12}$, lower bracket $\tau_0=10^{-12}\mathrm{SD}(y)$, upper-bracket expansion $b_0=2$ |
| Reported support size | Coefficient threshold $\epsilon_{\rm nz}=10^{-8}$ |
| Matched AMP/CD | Five timed repetitions, AMP limit $K_{\rm AMP}=1000$, CD tolerance $\epsilon_{\rm AMPfit}=10^{-9}$, limit $K_{\rm AMPfit}=10000$, external tolerances $\epsilon_{\rm R4}$ and $\epsilon_{\rm obj}$ |
| Three-option fixtures | $\epsilon_{\rm pilot}=10^{-7}$, $K_{\rm pilot}=500$, $p_N=0$, reference $\epsilon_{\rm ref}$ with $K_{\rm pilotref}=4000$ |
| Paired MM/root paths | $\epsilon_{\rm sim}$, $K_{\rm sim}$, $B=8$, $p_N=c_\kappa=5$, $T=2000$, soft path-time limit $T_{\rm path}=120$ seconds, checked between penalties |

: Experiment-specific controls. The standalone `update_scale` function defaults to tolerance $10^{-8}$. Estimator scale updates instead use $\epsilon_\sigma=\epsilon/2$. {#tbl-experiment-controls}
